name: context_cells
note: Cells addressed by exact recent suffixes, read through a log-opinion pool. Lean states the shape of the body with free functions; capability is the language gate's question.

mechanisms.what: an arrival is counted in the cell of the suffix that preceded it
an event touches the sense, context and pool units and a bounded set of cells
orders 1 to 6 are a design choice found by comparison, with no necessity theorem
trust by suffix length, evidence and longest suffix found, following the current byte's log loss; a design choice found by comparison
a new symbol displaces the weakest of its cell once the held total reaches its limit, so the budget is a hard bound
a cell settles elapsed time when next addressed

external_causal_readout_exists_iff.not_applicable: no external store: context, pool and cells all sit inside the counted state that O03 bounds, and nothing is read back from outside it

external_trace_requires_retrieved_distin.not_applicable: no external store: context, pool and cells all sit inside the counted state that O03 bounds, and nothing is read back from outside it

phases_must_balance.not_applicable: no free phase: a cell counts only the arrived byte, and its drift is a count update that is not claimed to be proportional to the likelihood gradient

reward_phases_must_balance.not_applicable: no reward signal reaches any cell

three_part_balance_impossible.not_applicable: no balanced unit: nothing moves at calm (calm_inactive), so detailed balance holds vacuously and every event is driven; the log-opinion pool reads up to six suffix orders, which a balanced unit could not
